correctness.rationale: Let C=binom(n,3), B=3C, a_j=(m)_j/(N)_j. The identity W=P-3T converts induced-wedge count into centered cherry P and triangle T. Direct overlap enumeration yields exact E[T],E[P],E[T^2],E[P^2],E[TP] with common-edge or fully disjoint edge-set union probabilities a_j. Independent rational graph enumeration of ALL labelled simple graphs for n=4,5,6 across all 34 edge-count strata reproduced the finite covariance and boundaries. A separate symbolic SymPy simplification verified for arbitrary n,m the factor -C*a3*6(N-m)(N-m-1)K/((n+1)(n+2)(N-5)(N-4)(N-2)). K>0 for n>=5; n=4 gives K=24-4m>0 for 3<=m<=4. When m<=2 no triangle; when m>=N-1 counts deterministic. In G(n,p), overlap on one edge gives 3 C p^4(1-p)[2(n-3)-(3n-8)p], with positive/negative transition threshold 2(n-3)/(3n-8). Symbolic dense-limit calculations independently recovered -p^4(1-p)^2 covariance coefficient and both variance constants, giving the stated correlation. The general result follows from overlap algebra and positivity, not extrapolation.

evidence: General subgraph statistic frameworks cover individual triangle/cherry deviations and possibly leading covariance, but not found to give exact all-parameter induced W covariance sign.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Even broad central limit theorems and moderate deviations do not imply a strict finite sign at every n,m and the precise independent-edge sign threshold.
